identity: A Jordanian school history / social-studies multiple-choice bank: 20 items, one per printed line, on ancient Egyptian writing and society, the Nabataeans, the Umayyads, the Islamic conquests, Palestinian cities, and Jordanian archaeology. Mixed three- and four-option items plus one true-false.
law: MCQ BANK (section I). Median line 11 tokens; the line is a question, so LINE MODE is overridden by the MCQ exception. I2 stem ends where the siblings begin, I3 each option is a unit, I5 internal wa never cuts. 232 real tokens / 93 units = 2.5 per unit.
reasoning: Unlike the four earlier banks this one has NO fixed option count - thirteen lines carry four options and six carry three (al-Umawi/al-Abbasi/al-Ayyubi; bilad al-Sham/al-Iraq/shamal Ifriqiya; al-wahda al-arabiyya/al-qadiyya al-filastiniyya/imarat sharq al-Urdunn; bina al-Masjid al-Aqsa/qubbat al-Sakhra/al-musalla al-Marwani; and the conquests line), and one is a true-false with the options REVERSED (khata before sahh). So the 2b constant cannot be used here as a check, and each stem had to be fixed on the dangling-word cue alone: bi-ism @4 and @184, fi @55 and @220, ala @95, hiya @80, huwa @110, ada @70, hatta @133, the bare lam @205, the bare ba @244 (inside the stem wasafaha al-misriyyun BI hisn al-khulud), and dangling idafa heads at @41, @122, @157, @195. The one line I argued over is @128-@141: reading the stem as wasala al-muslimun fi futuhatihim (4 tokens) would give options beginning sharqan hatta..., but hatta is a textbook I2 dangling preposition, so I ended the stem at hatta and read three direction+place siblings (janub Faransa sharqan / gharb al-Sin / janub al-Sudan gharban); I marked those four boundaries med rather than hi. Multi-token options stay whole throughout - liwa al-Ramtha, umm Qays, qalat Ajlun, qalat al-Karak, ithna ashra, adawat al-matbakh, qiyas ajza al-layl - and the last option of the document, al-maabid WA-AL-maqabir, keeps its internal wa under I5.
